description: Functional documentation group copied from Entity_Catalog.Domain. It is not a database namespace, user group, ABAC grant or clean-team membership.
Candidate explanation of the functional scope of the group.
Entity purpose copied from the source Entity_Catalog.
Proposed relation or entity name. Not a claim that an identical live table exists.
Proposed field name within Entity. Entity plus Field identifies a dictionary row.
Proposed PostgreSQL storage type, including declared precision or length where specified.
Proposed null constraint. NULL and absent data must not be treated as the same as an approved negative finding.
Proposed PK, FK or key annotation. Consult FK_Relationships for target and cardinality; the FK list is not necessarily exhaustive.
Source provenance category as supplied, such as VDR, WORKFLOW or SYSTEM. Not a permission.
Proposed confidentiality metadata. Actual access requires current deterministic policy and source lineage.
Proposal implementation priority as supplied, such as P1. Not risk rating, matter urgency or legal approval.
Unchanged source definition or constraint note. Blank means the workbook did not supply a note.
Source authority label. PROPOSED SCHEMA does not mean firm-approved or implemented.
Explicit target-design status for every row. No DDL is executed by these files.
Readable definition from a source note or FK mapping, otherwise an explicitly identified candidate gloss.
Identifies whether the description was copied from source evidence or inferred for explanation.
